title: Social Short-form lab 3 (source of the round-3 9:16 templates)
summary: The 8 vertical comps the round-3 Social Short-form templates were built and verified in: story tap-through, link in bio, POV hook, comment reply, this or that, price drop, giveaway rules and reaction picture-in-picture.
use_when: You want to see a round-3 vertical template working before using it, copy a comp's objects into a 9:16 piece, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing its copy.
parameters: text content (plates behind the POV lines and the REACTING TO tag are sized with cc.textw)
ST_SEG / ST_PER, POV_LINES, TT, RULES in social_short_form_lab3.py
panel stand-ins (replace with clips or stills)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-28
copy_notes: No media; nothing to relink. Handles, prices, the URL and the clip and product panels are invented stand-ins.
Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (sst_, slb_, spv_, scr_, sto_, spd_, sga_, srx_).
Place 9:16 templates into a comp formatted 1080 x 1920 first (comp.format).

Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/social_short_form_lab3.py writes the comps (cc.textw needs Pillow); every move is baked as keys (Hook punch, Whip in - left and the badge pop written as keys), no presets to apply; open the file with edit.open {force:true}, then edit.save.
Every comp lints 0 errors / 0 warnings / 0 notes; bounds_inside the safe box [61, 268, 955, 1270] passes for every object, and nothing reaches right of x 851 below y 1151.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-28
